candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits only an analysis carrying normative grounding, source distinctions, and unresolved conflicts. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, and loop_structure, has no direct visibility of task, anchor_contract, or task_constraints, and emits one complete policy.

candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with categorical inversion of terminal source-class visibility

Consume ground_before_inversion, directly assess the visible generative sources against predecessor-carried obligations, resolve preserved conflicts, and emit one complete policy.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Invert terminal source-class aperture polarity once: confine direct normative inputs to the first call and grant the final call direct visibility of the generative sources alongside the predecessor analysis.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Terminal authorship becomes directly responsive to unresolved inherited-versus-counter evidence while normative grounding occurs earlier and remains visible through the sole analysis handoff.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Permanent generative-source isolation makes terminal authorship depend on an upstream interpretation of the very inherited and counter-generative tensions that may require direct resolution.

structural_mutation.after: The terminal authority directly reacquires generative sources while normative sources are available only through the immediately preceding analysis.
structural_mutation.before: The terminal authority directly reacquires normative sources while all generative sources are permanently cut.
structural_mutation.why_structural: This categorically reverses terminal input-edge visibility and the evidence class holding final authority; it is neither role renaming nor terminal-call fission.
